topic: What beam management strategies are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band?
consensus_response: High-gain beams exacerbate efficiency fluctuations due to narrow beamwidth and increased path loss, leading to inter-beam interference. Adaptive beamforming with digital predistortion is crucial for dynamic adjustment and minimizing inter-beam interference.  However, this requires efficient spectrum management techniques like beam tracking algorithms to mitigate latency and bandwidth constraints. Dynamic power allocation based on real-time CSI is another promising strategy for optimizing spectral utilization and minimizing inter-beam interference.
